title: Include Associated Data Code System
description: Metadata inclusion options for Bulk Data Access Export Operation includeAssociatedData parameter

concept.definition: A Data Provider supporting this value SHALL include the most recent available Provenance resource associated with each non-Provenance resource being returned in the export, as identified by `Provenance.target`. This applies to the resources selected after all other applicable export parameters and filters have been applied, including `_type`, `_typeFilter`, `_since`, `_until`, and `patient`. The associated Provenance resources SHALL be included regardless of whether `Provenance` is specified in `_type` or whether the Provenance resources themselves satisfy the other filtering criteria. This value does not exclude Provenance resources that would otherwise be returned as part of the export.

A Data Provider supporting this value SHALL include all available Provenance resources associated with each non-Provenance resource being returned in the export, as identified by `Provenance.target`. This applies to the resources selected after all other applicable export parameters and filters have been applied, including `_type`, `_typeFilter`, `_since`, `_until`, and `patient`. The associated Provenance resources SHALL be included regardless of whether `Provenance` is specified in `_type` or whether the Provenance resources themselves satisfy the other filtering criteria. This value does not exclude Provenance resources that would otherwise be returned as part of the export.
